title: Gray-Box Hallucination Detection in LLMs with Token Identities
abstract: arXiv:2610.19996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models often produce fluent but factually incorrect output. Gray-box detectors identify such hallucinations from the token-probability statistics emitted during generation, avoiding the need for white-box access to hidden states that frontier models do not provide. These detectors, however, typically rely only on probability-derived representations and ignore the identities of the candidate tokens. They can therefore observe how uncertain the model is, but not what it is uncertain about. Consequently, they cannot distinguish between a model that is torn between "big" and "small" and one that is torn between "big" and "huge" when the two pairs receive the same probability distribution.   We introduce GURI (Gray-box Uncertainty Representations with Identity), a lightweight gray-box hallucination detector that combines candidate-token probabilities with per-token vector identifiers. translated_title: 基于词元身份的大语言模型灰盒幻觉检测
translated_abstract: 大语言模型经常产生流畅但事实上错误的输出。灰盒检测器利用生成过程中输出的词元概率统计信息来识别此类幻觉，从而避免了对隐藏状态进行白盒访问的需求，而前沿模型并不提供这种访问。然而，这些检测器通常仅依赖于由概率派生的表示，而忽略了候选词元的身份信息。因此，它们只能观察到模型有多不确定，却无法观察到模型对什么不确定。 consequently，当“big”与“small”这一对词和“big”与“huge”这一对词具有相同的概率分布时，它们无法区分模型究竟是在“大”和“小”之间犹豫，还是在“大”和“巨大”之间犹豫。我们提出了GURI（Gray-box Uncertainty Representations with Identity，带身份的灰盒不确定性表示），这是一种轻量级的灰盒幻觉检测器，它将候选词元概率与每个词元的向量标识符相结合。这使得模型正在权衡的备选词元得以显现……（摘要不完整，原文截断）
tldr: 本文提出GURI，一种轻量级灰盒幻觉检测器，通过将候选词元概率与词元身份向量标识符相结合，不仅能衡量模型的不确定程度，还能识别模型不确定的具体对象，从而实现更精细的大语言模型幻觉检测。
en_tdlr: GURI is a lightweight gray-box hallucination detector that combines candidate-token probabilities with per-token identity vectors, allowing it to capture not only how uncertain an LLM is but also what it is uncertain about.
